purpose: Frozen B1 mutation patch set. Every mutation is specified as an exact edit to a digest-pinned file, with its gate commands, baseline requirement, committed prediction and classification rule fixed BEFORE any mutation is applied.
supersedes: phase-b-roadmap.v1.json B1 stage definition, which listed twelve mutation THEMES and left enough implementer discretion to change whether a mutation survives.
note: Timestamps are deliberately omitted: this package must be byte-reproducible. Ordering is established by git history.

globalProtocol.isolation: Each mutation is applied in its OWN dedicated `git clone --no-hardlinks` at the audited commit. No mutation is ever applied to the primary checkout, and no two mutations share a clone.
globalProtocol.baselineGreenRequirement: Before applying any mutation, the clone MUST reproduce the declared baseline: `npm ci` exit 0, then `npm test` exit 0 under Node 25.x. A clone that is not green before mutation is discarded and rebuilt. A mutation applied to an already-failing tree proves nothing.
globalProtocol.nodeRuntime: Node 25.x for all B1 gates. Node 22.13.1 fails tests/observed-experiment.test.mjs at baseline for the reason established in the C1 addendum, so it cannot serve as a mutation baseline.
globalProtocol.patchApplication: Each patch is a single-line substitution. Before applying, `git hash-object --no-filters <target>` MUST equal the pinned digest below. If it does not, the patch is not applied and the discrepancy is reported.
globalProtocol.regenerationStep: A mutation to a GENERATOR or INGEST script has no effect until the corresponding artifact is regenerated. Each mutation below states its regeneration command explicitly, or states that none is required.
globalProtocol.restoration: After each mutation, restore by `git checkout --force -- <target>` and CONFIRM by re-checking the raw digest against the pin before the next mutation. Restoration is verified, never assumed.

classificationRule.DETECTED: At least one declared gate command exits non-zero, AND the failure names the mutated quantity or an artifact derived from it. A gate that fails for an unrelated reason is recorded as INCONCLUSIVE, not DETECTED.
classificationRule.SURVIVED: Every declared gate command exits zero.
classificationRule.INCONCLUSIVE: A gate fails for a reason unrelated to the mutation, or the baseline was not green, or the pinned digest did not match.

globalProtocol.predictionDiscipline: Every expectedVerdict below is committed in this file before any mutation is executed. A prediction that proves wrong is recorded as wrong; it is not revised after the fact.

targetDigestPins.note: All digests are RAW on-disk (git hash-object --no-filters). wadhwa-2022-events.json differs from its index blob because .gitattributes pins it to eol=crlf; the raw digest is the one a patch must match.

structuralObservationDeclaredInAdvance.finding: tests/observed-experiment.test.mjs:41 asserts deepStrictEqual between a fresh run and the committed frozen report. This is a very BROAD detector: it fires on ANY change to any field of that report.
structuralObservationDeclaredInAdvance.consequence: Several mutations below are predicted DETECTED solely because of this assertion. That is a regression lock, not a semantic check. It proves the report changed; it proves nothing about whether the mutated semantics were wrong.
structuralObservationDeclaredInAdvance.whyThisIsDeclaredBeforeExecution: So that a high DETECTED count cannot later be presented as evidence that the suite understands the science. The mutation ledger must separate semantic detectors from the regression lock, and each row below names which kind fired.

mutations.expectedDetector: tests/observed-experiment.test.mjs:41 frozen-report deepStrictEqual (REGRESSION LOCK), via changed direction metrics
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: H4, that training-only state-conditioned direction frequencies predict held-out on/off events

mutations.theme: Species label swapped between E. coli behavioural and Salmonella structural evidence
mutations.expectedDetector: tests/walkthrough.test.mjs:45-49, which pins Mears to E. coli and asserts pairwise species inequality over non-empty filters
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: The truth contract requirement that E. coli behavioural evidence stays separate from Salmonella and Bacillus structural evidence

mutations.theme: Truth laundering: a structural reconstruction relabelled OBSERVED
mutations.expectedDetector: lib/walkthrough.js:470 validator, which rejects any deposited structure labelled OBSERVED
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: CLAUDE.md: a reconstruction may never be relabelled observed

mutations.theme: Truth laundering: a DERIVED product labelled OBSERVED — the control for M03a
mutations.target: none; this is an OBSERVATION of the unmutated tree
mutations.unmutatedState: lib/walkthrough.js:71-72 already pairs evidenceType 'derived' with sourceClass 'OBSERVED' for WADHWA_2022_EVENTS.
mutations.expectedDetector: none — the :470 guard is scoped to asset.kind === 'structure' only
mutations.whyThisIsIncluded: M03a and M03b are a matched pair. If M03a is DETECTED and M03b SURVIVES, the suite is shown to guard one relabelling route and not the other, which is a sharper result than either alone. M03b requires no mutation because the condition is already live at the audited commit.
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: CLAUDE.md: a derived field may never be relabelled observed

mutations.patchRationale: A uniform positive scaling leaves the RATIO of components unchanged, so any downstream quantity that renormalizes is unaffected, while any quantity that assumes the input already sums to one is corrupted. This isolates whether normalization is genuinely enforced or merely assumed.
mutations.predictionRationale: normalize() divides by the sum of the scaled values, so a uniform factor cancels exactly. The mutation is expected to be invisible. If it IS detected, some consumer is depending on the pre-division magnitudes, which would itself be a finding.
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: That posteriors and policy distributions are proper distributions

mutations.theme: Sign inversion on a paired model-comparison difference
mutations.patchRationale: The audit prompt names 'invert residual signs'. The JS core contains no quantity named 'residual'; the nearest load-bearing signed quantity is the paired advantage that H2's success criterion reads. This substitution is declared rather than silently made.
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: H2, the direction of the held-out log-score advantage

mutations.theme: Censoring treatment: right-censored dwells admitted to the uncensored likelihood
mutations.expectedDetector: tests/observed-experiment.test.mjs:41 frozen-report deepStrictEqual (REGRESSION LOCK), via changed cohort counts
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: The frozen extraction rule that right-censored dwells are excluded from uncensored duration likelihoods

mutations.theme: Motor-leakage guard removed, with no leak actually injected
mutations.before: if ([...trainIds].some((id) => holdoutIdsAll.has(id))) throw new Error("Motor leakage detected.");
mutations.after: if (false) throw new Error("Motor leakage detected.");
mutations.predictionRationale: The split is a pure function of sha256(motorId) mod 5, so no leak exists to detect. Removing the guard changes no output. This measures whether the guard is PROTECTED by anything, not whether leakage is prevented.
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: That the leakage control is itself defended, rather than relying on a structural property nobody re-checks

mutations.theme: Actual train/holdout motor identity leak injected, guard intact
mutations.method: In the clone, edit experiments/data/wadhwa-2022-events.json so that exactly one motorId currently in the holdout partition has its `partition` field changed to "train" on a single event, leaving splitRemainder untouched. This creates a motor whose events span both partitions.
mutations.whyPairedWithM07a: M07a asks whether the guard is protected. M07b asks whether the guard works. Both answers are needed; neither substitutes for the other.

mutations.theme: Experimental-unit inflation: events counted as independent units
mutations.before: wadhwa_motors = len({event["motorId"] for event in wadhwa["events"]})
mutations.effect: Wadhwa's contribution to the pooled independent-unit count rises from 109 to 1349, and the X02 total from 409 to 1649 against a threshold of 400.
mutations.blockedPrecondition: scripts/ingest-cross-study-evidence.py requires experiments/upstream-cache/, which is absent from a clean clone. This mutation is therefore BLOCKED unless the Tier-1 cache is staged into the clone first. If it cannot be staged, the mutation is recorded NOT RUN, never SURVIVED.
mutations.expectedDetector: X02 would still PASS, more easily. Detection, if any, comes only from tests/cross-study-parity.test.mjs:76-80 re-hashing the regenerated artifacts.
mutations.criticalObservation: The GATE does not resist this mutation: inflating the unit count makes X02 pass by a wider margin. Only the artifact hash notices anything changed. This is the pseudoreplication CLAUDE.md explicitly forbids, and no gate tests for it.

mutations.expectedDetector: tests/walkthrough.test.mjs:58, which hashes each asset on disk and compares against the pin
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: The evidence-manifest chain from source bytes to published identity

mutations.theme: Adverse result removed from the report
mutations.method: Apply M05's sign inversion, which reverses the reported ordering so the mixture appears to out-score the lognormal.
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: Retention of the adverse finding that a lognormal baseline out-scores the project's own model

mutations.theme: The adverse-result PROTECTION removed — the control for M10a
mutations.predictionRationale: The adverse result is protected by exactly one assertion. Removing it should leave every gate green, which would show the protection is a single point of failure.
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: That the repository's most important self-criticism is durably defended rather than defended once

mutations.effect: The protocol now claims to have been frozen AFTER the results it governs were computed.
mutations.expectedDetector: none for the ordering itself; the frozen-report regression lock may fire only because the protocol digest changed
mutations.criticalObservation: Nothing in the repository checks TEMPORAL ORDERING between a protocol freeze and the results it governs. Phase A established there are no tags, no signatures and no external timestamps, so git cannot corroborate ordering either. A hash change is detected; a false prospectivity claim is not.
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: CLAUDE.md: a prediction is prospective only if it was committed before its observation

mutations.theme: Physical work conflated with variational free energy
mutations.patchRationale: Multiplying a joule quantity by kB*T is a unit-category error of exactly the kind the truth contract forbids: it silently converts an energy into a dimensionless-scaled quantity while the field name still says joules.
mutations.expectedDetector: tests/walkthrough.test.mjs numerical-anchor test, which reproduces the pencil-and-paper values
mutations.scientificClaimEndangered: CLAUDE.md: thermodynamic work and variational free energy must retain separate units

headlinePredictions: M10b: the adverse lognormal result is protected by exactly ONE assertion, and removing it leaves every gate green.
M11: no gate checks temporal ordering, so a falsified prospectivity claim is invisible except as a hash change.
M08: inflating the experimental-unit count makes X02 pass MORE easily; the gate does not resist pseudoreplication.
M03b: the derived-labelled-OBSERVED route is already live and unguarded, while the structural route is guarded.

deliverable: audits/phase-b/b1-mutation-ledger.json, one row per mutation with observed verdict, the exact gate output that fired or did not, the detector kind, and an explicit comparison against the prediction committed here.
uncertainty: M08 is BLOCKED on a clean clone because its regeneration requires the absent upstream cache. If the cache cannot be staged, M08 is recorded NOT RUN, never SURVIVED. M07b requires hand-editing a 508103-byte CRLF data file; the edit must preserve the file's line endings or the CRLF defect will confound the result.
alternativeExplanation: n/a — this is a protocol, not an empirical claim.
independentlyReproduced: Not yet executed. Codex identified that the roadmap's twelve themes left enough discretion to change whether a mutation survives, which is what this patch set removes.
